build_llm_translate_pipeline: build an LLM-based translation filter pipeline for Open WebUI that translates user and assistant messages
test_translate_function: test the translate function that sends text to an OpenAI-compatible API for translation
run_inlet_filter: run the inlet filter to translate incoming user messages before they reach the model
run_outlet_filter: run the outlet filter to translate outgoing assistant messages after model response
configure_pipeline_valves: configure pipeline valves to set API keys, target languages, and model selection
